Product singularities recover smallest angle and multiplicity; analytic division and finite induction recover all angles. Standalone verify.py passed 1787 independent calculations including angle-singularity coefficient quadrature.

value.rationale: A natural random boundary observation loses global polygon metric data, yet its complete first-order perimeter-limit law recovers every local interior angle with multiplicity. The exact characterization of retained versus lost information applies uniformly to arbitrary fixed convex polygons. The MGF singularities provide a structural inverse mechanism not available from scalar mean errors and do not merely compute a known table.
